أتعاضد (form VI)
# أَتَعَاضَدُ (ʔataʕāḍadu) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.dˤa.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَعَاضَدَ (taʕāḍada)
# أَتَعَاضَدَ (ʔataʕāḍada) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.dˤa.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَعَاضَدَ (taʕāḍada)
# أَتَعَاضَدْ (ʔataʕāḍad) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.dˤad/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَعَاضَدَ (taʕāḍada)
